_about: MCP for PMs. Vendor-official servers only, in the order a PM meets them (discover, define, plan, roadmap, design, build, measure, communicate). Community servers appear only when the vendor has no official one. Reviewed quarterly (data/state.json > last_quarterly_review); every link must answer 200.

rows.use: Connect your agent to the Dovetail API so research can feed discovery docs and specs. Runs locally with your API token.
Read and write docs, databases, and wikis. Summarize meeting notes, update specs.
Search and summarize Jira and Confluence, create and update issues and pages. Cloud only.
Manage issues, projects, and cycles. Pull sprint context into PRD drafts.
Pull current specs into a coding agent, post questions back, and update status.
Give agents the real components, variables, and layout from your Figma files. The remote server is on all seats and plans.
Review PRs, search issues, understand codebase context without asking engineering.
Ask product-analytics questions in plain text and let the agent query PostHog. The hosted endpoint is free to connect.
Query and create charts, dashboards, experiments, and cohorts in plain language. For existing Amplitude customers.
Search channels and read threads for past decisions, and catch up on a project. Workspace admins approve each client.
